**Finding: missing (insurance) — redline proposed and accepted.**

The Agreement has no insurance clause. The sole "insurance" reference (p0051) merely makes Licensee responsible for taxes, shipping and insurance charges — it imposes no coverage obligation on Licensor. Since SFG/E-Path FX hosts the Platform and processes our trading and account data, the playbook's standard coverages apply.

Redline: new General Provisions subsection (l) after p0159 requiring Licensor to carry CGL of USD 1M per occurrence / 2M aggregate, E&O of USD 2M, cyber/privacy of USD 5M, and statutory workers' compensation, for the term plus one year, with certificates on request. Fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) flagged in the comment for negotiation.
